ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.description: Add screen blend mode image onto canvas. Only the light survives.

stain.name: Stain
stain.description: Add an image overlay with a multiply blend mode onto the canvas. Darkness multiplies.

stamp.name: Stamp
stamp.description: Cut out an image and stamp it onto the canvas.

rails.name: Rails
rails.description: Adds a fractured monochromatic shard onto the canvas.

char.name: Char
char.description: The fragments scorch what is beneath — arrange them, set the depth of the burn.

deeper.name: Deeper
deeper.description: The frame is the piece’s next edge. Move it, scale it from the corners, rotate it — whatever it holds becomes the whole canvas.

rack.name: Rack
rack.description: The piece is racked to a new vessel: drag, scale, rotate. What leaves the frame is gone; what the frame exposes stays white.

lift.name: Lift
lift.description: Copy a rectangle of the piece and stamp it down elsewhere. The source stays where it is — a second impression, cropped where it runs off the edge.

dust.name: Dust
dust.description: Paint where the dust should settle. Nothing changes until you paint.

bruise.name: Bruise
bruise.description: Set the discoloration, then paint where the image should bruise.

blur.name: Blur
blur.description: use a brush to blur the surface of the canvas.

steep.name: Steep
steep.description: The piece steeps in a dye bath. Influence is steeping time.

hue.name: Hue
hue.description: Apply HSV modification to the entire canvas.

cure.name: Cure
cure.description: The piece cures in its own bath — mids deepen, tone richens. Influence is how far the cure has gone.

etch.name: Subliminal Etch
etch.description: Etch a small glyph at the grain. At full size it will be almost nothing.

searcher.name: Searcher
searcher.description: Pick a card from the deck, this becomes your next turn.

skim.name: Skim
skim.description: Reveal the next card, choose to play it or re-shuffle it into the deck.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: The first Coda card can be skipped. The Coda card is shuffled back into the deck when skipped. It may appear again next turn anyway.

transfer.name: Transfer
transfer.description: The whole piece has been redrawn. Erase to cut the original back through; influence sets how strongly the redraw sits.

shatteredTransfer.name: Shattered Transfer
shatteredTransfer.description: The piece’s redraw shows through another image’s most shattered form.

coda.name: Coda
coda.description: The piece is finished. The session ends here.

shared.takeOne: Take one image from the grid.
shared.shattering: Reading the image for its most shattered form…

brush.restore: Paint to bring erased areas of {subject} back.
brush.soften: Paint along an erased edge to feather it.

ghost.pickHint: Eight images. Take one — it joins the piece as a second exposure: only its light survives.
ghost.subject: the ghost

stain.pickHint: Eight images. Take one — it soaks into the piece: only its dark survives.
stain.subject: the stain

stamp.pickHint: Six images. Take one — its subject is cut out and stamped onto the piece.
stamp.cutting: Cutting out the subject… on a machine's first cutout this downloads the model and can take a minute.
stamp.degraded: The cutout service is unavailable, so the whole image was placed — the erase brush is your scissors.
stamp.subject: the stamp

lift.takeHint: Drag a rectangle over the piece — on release a copy lifts free and follows your hand. Stamp as many as the round wants.
lift.carryHint: Click to stamp the copy where it hangs. Esc discards it.

etch.frameHint: Drag the small frame to where the mark should hide. Its size is fixed — about a hundred pixels of the piece.
etch.grainHint: You are at the grain — every square is one pixel of the piece. Etch a small glyph. At full size it will be almost nothing.

skim.title: SKIM
skim.emptyDeck: The deck is empty — there is nothing on top.
skim.choiceHint: Leave it or bury it — you won't see what replaces it.
skim.bury: Bury it — somewhere back in the deck
skim.kept: It waits on top. End the round.
skim.buried: Gone — somewhere back in the deck. The next deal is unknown. End the round.
skim.toolWaiting: On the canvas: turn the top card, then leave it or bury it.

searcher.title: Searcher
searcher.emptyDeck: The deck has nothing left to offer.
searcher.footChosen: take it — or click again to put it back
searcher.toolWaiting: Take the card the piece needs.
searcher.toolReady: The deck had nothing left to offer — a round with no modification. End it.

delay.toolSuffix: The card waits at the deal panel. End the round.

deeper.commitNote: End commits the re-frame and restores detail into the enlargement; that takes a few seconds.

transfer.working: The piece is being redrawn in another hand… a few seconds.
transfer.degraded: The transfer service is unavailable — the piece stands as it is. End to move on.

shatteredTransfer.pickHint: Six images. Take one — it won't be placed; it will be read as a stencil, and the piece's redraw shows through its shattered form.
shatteredTransfer.confirm: Continue — read it as a stencil
shatteredTransfer.arrangeWaiting: This image {reading} — place the stencil where the style should break through. The redraw is still arriving; the window opens when it lands.
shatteredTransfer.degraded: The transfer service is unavailable — the stencil is withdrawn and the piece stands as it is. End to move on.
shatteredTransfer.windowOpen: The window is open{readingClause}. Drag, scale, rotate the stencil; the redraw shows through wherever it sits.
shatteredTransfer.subject: the styled fragments

commission.title: THE COMMISSION
commission.panelHint: A cast is one session for one face. Pick the card from the grid — its name and type line will follow it onto the plate.
commission.pickHint: Every cast opens on a commission — the card this face is for. Choose one, or let the deck decide. The ×count is the card's presence in a deck: a ×2 design runs two impressions from one base.

plate.title: THE PLATE
plate.panelHint: Casting **{label}**. Take one of the dealt plates from the table.
plate.setHint: The full set of {count} plate{plural} — choose the one this face calls for. Its frame is the card's convention layer; the white window is the punched image panel, waiting for art.

panel.title: THE PANEL
panel.pickPanelHint: Take an image from the grid. Or continue with the window empty — the white shows, and the graffiti decides what it becomes.
panel.artFromFallback: Panel art from the input + export folders — point it at a dedicated folder to curate the card imagery apart from the main pool.
panel.arrangeHint: Arrange the art under the window — the plate's edge crops whatever crosses it.
panel.liveUntilPress: Everything stays live until the Press.
panel.subject: the art
panel.gridHint: Take an image for the window — your finished pieces and raw inputs, dealt together. It lands under the plate; the window crops it.

type.title: THE TYPE
type.hint: The type is set — name upper-left, type line upper-right, the description in its box. **Double-click** a slot to edit its text; drag to nudge, handles to size. The description box resizes to fit the plate's text region.
type.pressNote: The Press seals the whole foundation — art, plate, and type flatten to pixels for good. After it, the graffiti deck works the sealed face.

plateTint.hint: The plate — re-color the frame itself. The art under the window keeps its own color.

ink.selectNote: (select a slot on the card to ink it alone)

working.title: THE WORKING DECK
working.placeholder: (placeholder — scribble on the face; this card's real tool arrives in Phase 5)

proof.title: THE PROOF
proof.tailNext: — the base waits for the next.
proof.exporting: Writing the cast to your casts folder…
proof.dropIn: Drop-in ready: to put it in play, copy it to `assets/cards/{file}` and reload Deck. The full-res master sits alongside.
proof.nextImpression: Next impression — return to the base

progress.late: late — the Proofs are in the deck

setup.title: ZYME
setup.subtitle: Choose your folders
setup.inputPlaceholderNoHome: absolute path to your input folder
setup.outputHint: Where finished compositions will be saved.
setup.outputPlaceholderNoHome: absolute path to your output folder
setup.pickerFailed: Could not open a folder picker.
setup.pickerFailedDetail: Could not open a folder picker: {message}
setup.footnote: Paths support a leading `~` for your home directory. Folders must exist before continuing.
setup.cardSetsHint: A folder of alternate deck designs — one subfolder per set, each holding PNGs named by card id. Leave empty for the built-in faces.
setup.cardSetsPlaceholder: absolute path to your card faces folder
setup.cardSetsEmpty: No sets in that folder yet — add a subfolder of card PNGs.

deckEditor.title: Deck editor
deckEditor.subtitle: Assemble the deck the next session deals from. Codas are never edited here — three are always shuffled in late.
deckEditor.tooFew: Too few — add cards to reach the minimum.
deckEditor.namePlaceholder: name this deck to save it

deckPanel.openingHint: Take **two** from the grid: one placed now, one stashed — it comes back after Act I.
deckPanel.inputErrorHint: Go back to setup to pick a different folder.
deckPanel.noImagesHint: Add some `.png` / `.jpg` / `.jpeg` / `.webp` files to your input folder, then reload.
deckPanel.stashReturnHint: Your stashed image comes back — arrange it like the opening.
deckPanel.arrangeHint: Drag to move, corner handles to scale, top handle to rotate.
deckPanel.endBakes: End bakes everything in for good.
deckPanel.delayHeld: held — the first Coda can be set aside
deckPanel.codaHint: The deck says the piece is finished. You still hold Delay — accept the ending, or set the Coda aside. It slips back into the deck and the next deal is blind: it can come straight back, and the right is spent.
deckPanel.toolsPlaceholder: (placeholder — this card's tools arrive in a later phase)
deckPanel.exporting: Writing PNG to your output folder…

opening.title: THE OPENING
opening.hint: Take two: one to *place now*, one to *stash for later* — or click the stashed one again to *place both*, holding nothing back.

deckOverlay.title: THE DECK
deckOverlay.spentEmpty: Nothing yet — the sequence begins with the first committed card.
deckOverlay.codaSomewhere: …and the Coda is somewhere in here.
deckOverlay.close: Click anywhere or press Esc to close.

keys.title: KEYS
keys.close: Click anywhere or press Esc to close.

always.title: Always
always.Enter: The primary action — End, Deal, begin again. Never confirms the opening pick.
always.Shift+R: Restart. It destroys the piece, so it takes two keys.
always.Esc: Back out: deselect, put a grid pick back, discard a copy in hand, close this.

brush.title: Brush in hand
brush.[ ]: Brush size, steps of 5 — 10 with Shift. Shift+drag on the canvas also resizes.
brush.W: Arrange — where there is something to arrange.
brush.Cmd/Ctrl+Z: Undo a stroke — add Shift to redo. Never crosses an End.

certainCards.title: On certain cards
certainCards.Enter: Confirm a grid pick. Etch: zoom in.
certainCards.N: A new hue on any color control.

atTheCoda.title: At the Coda
atTheCoda.C: Cycle through previous states of the composition

progress.late: late — the Coda is in the deck
